verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's own docs show retention-related controls: you can restrict requests, per request or account-wide, to providers with a given data policy, and you can opt out of providers that may train on your data. A community user confirms a global 'ZDR-only' toggle. Nothing in the pack shows that users can delete stored data, and the doubts about ZDR guarantees are general skepticism, not concrete contradiction. missing for 10: any user-controlled data deletion capability, documented OpenRouter-side retention periods or log retention controls, independent verification that retention filtering works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can restrict individual requests to only use providers with a certain data policy. This is also available as an account-wide setting in your privacy settings.
On your account settings page, you can set whether you would like to allow routing to providers that may train on your data (according to their own policies).
many enable a global 'ZDR-only' toggle on OR
